```{r}
habitat_data   <- read.csv("7.18_CoverClassPercent_clean.csv")
call_data      <- read.csv("long_all_call_data_2021_2024.csv")
dip_data       <- read.csv("dipnet_data_2019_2024_JAS.csv")
hydro_data     <- read.csv("WetlandHydroperiod_2024_EK.csv")
wet_near_data  <- read.csv("wetlands_nearby_clean.csv")
ratio_data     <- read.csv("ratio_b_tof_1.csv")  # must contain Site, WetlandID, ratio_1_f_to_b
egg_data       <- readr::read_csv("egg_mass_clean_capito.csv")
```

```{r}
# --- Robust dates + safe Month/Year/YearIndex ---
# (requires lubridate)
library(lubridate)

# --- Robust date for CALLS: prefer Date2 (yyyymmdd), else parse Date1 ---
library(lubridate)
call_data <- call_data %>%
  mutate(
    Date2_chr = trimws(as.character(Date2)),
    use_d2    = !is.na(Date2_chr) & grepl("^\\d{8}$", Date2_chr),
    d_from_d2 = suppressWarnings(ymd(ifelse(use_d2, Date2_chr, NA_character_))),
    d_from_d1 = {
      x <- trimws(as.character(Date1))
      # try mdy first (e.g., "4/5/22"), then ymd, then dmy
      d <- suppressWarnings(mdy(x))
      bad <- is.na(d)
      if (any(bad)) d[bad] <- suppressWarnings(ymd(x[bad]))
      bad <- is.na(d)
      if (any(bad)) d[bad] <- suppressWarnings(dmy(x[bad]))
      d
    },
    Date_call = coalesce(d_from_d2, d_from_d1)  # final date
  )

# If anything still weird, try to catch out-of-range years and re-parse the other way
sus <- is.na(call_data$Date_call) | year(call_data$Date_call) < 2018 | year(call_data$Date_call) > 2026
if (any(sus)) {
  # last-ditch: swap-day-month attempt on those rows
  x <- trimws(as.character(call_data$Date1[sus]))
  d_alt <- suppressWarnings(dmy(x))
  call_data$Date_call[sus & !is.na(d_alt)] <- d_alt[!is.na(d_alt)]
}

# Use the clean date
call_data$Date1 <- as.Date(call_data$Date_call)

# Rebuild Month/Year/YearIndex from the clean column
call_data$Month <- factor(month(call_data$Date1, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE), levels = month.name)
call_data$Year  <- year(call_data$Date1)

# Parse DIP dates (supports Excel serials or mixed strings)
if (is.numeric(dip_data$Date)) {
  dip_data$Date <- as.Date(dip_data$Date, origin = "1899-12-30")
} else if (!inherits(dip_data$Date, "Date")) {
  dd <- suppressWarnings(ymd(dip_data$Date))
  miss <- is.na(dd)
  if (any(miss)) dd[miss] <- suppressWarnings(mdy(dip_data$Date[miss]))
  miss <- is.na(dd)
  if (any(miss)) dd[miss] <- suppressWarnings(dmy(dip_data$Date[miss]))
  dip_data$Date <- as.Date(dd)
}

# Harmonize site names
fix_sites <- function(x) dplyr::recode(x,
  "Ceylon" = "Ceylon WMA",
  "Jones Center" = "Jones Center Ichauway",
  "ARWMA" = "Alapaha River WMA",
  "TWMA" = "Townsend WMA"
)

call_data$Site     <- fix_sites(call_data$Site)
dip_data$Site      <- fix_sites(dip_data$Site)
habitat_data$Site  <- fix_sites(habitat_data$Site)
hydro_data$Site    <- fix_sites(hydro_data$Site)
wet_near_data$Site <- fix_sites(wet_near_data$Site)
ratio_data$Site    <- fix_sites(ratio_data$Site)

# Keep only Ceylon WMA & Jones Center Ichauway in all tables
keep_sites <- c("Ceylon WMA", "Jones Center Ichauway")
call_data     <- call_data    %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
dip_data      <- dip_data     %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
habitat_data  <- habitat_data %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
hydro_data    <- hydro_data   %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
wet_near_data <- wet_near_data%>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)
ratio_data    <- ratio_data   %>% filter(Site %in% keep_sites)

# Standardize column name to match the rest of the pipeline
if ("wetland_id" %in% names(ratio_data) && !("WetlandID" %in% names(ratio_data))) {
  ratio_data <- ratio_data %>% rename(WetlandID = wetland_id)
}

# Subset to study wetlands only (Site+WetlandID present in hydro)
key_h <- hydro_data %>% distinct(Site, WetlandID)
call_data    <- call_data    %>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))
dip_data     <- dip_data     %>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))
habitat_data <- habitat_data %>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))
wet_near_data<- wet_near_data%>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))
ratio_data   <- ratio_data   %>% semi_join(key_h, by=c("Site","WetlandID"))


# Species recode (only need LICAP) — keep other species as-is
call_data$Species <- dplyr::recode(call_data$Species,
  "LICAP" = "Rana capito", "Rana capito" = "Rana capito",
  .default = call_data$Species)

dip_data$Species  <- dplyr::recode(dip_data$Species,
  "LICAP" = "Rana capito", "Rana capito" = "Rana capito",
  .default = dip_data$Species)

# Keep only Rana capito for detections
call_data <- call_data %>% filter(Species == "Rana capito")
dip_data  <- dip_data  %>% filter(Species == "Rana capito")

# Fix call score (treat NA as 0; also cap 4 -> 3 if present)
call_data$Call_Score[is.na(call_data$Call_Score)] <- 0
call_data$Call_Score[call_data$Call_Score == 4] <- 3
call_data$Detected <- as.integer(call_data$Call_Score > 0)

# Month & Year (robust)
call_data$Month <- factor(month(call_data$Date1, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                          levels = month.name)
dip_data$Month  <- factor(month(dip_data$Date,  label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
                          levels = month.name)

if (!"Year" %in% names(call_data) || all(is.na(call_data$Year))) {
  call_data$Year <- year(call_data$Date1)
}
if (!"Year" %in% names(dip_data)  || all(is.na(dip_data$Year))) {
  dip_data$Year <- year(dip_data$Date)
}

# Years (union) + indices
all_years <- sort(unique(c(call_data$Year, dip_data$Year)))
call_data$YearIndex <- match(call_data$Year, all_years)
dip_data$YearIndex  <- match(dip_data$Year , all_years)

nYear   <- length(all_years)
nMonths <- 12


```

```{r}
site_levels <- factor(keep_sites, levels = keep_sites) # ensure order: Ceylon, Jones
nSites <- length(site_levels)

# Count wetlands per site (from hydro)
nWetlands_tbl <- hydro_data %>%
  group_by(Site) %>% summarise(nWet = n_distinct(WetlandID), .groups="drop") %>%
  complete(Site = site_levels, fill = list(nWet = 0)) %>%
  arrange(Site)

nWetlands_vec <- nWetlands_tbl$nWet
maxWetlands   <- max(nWetlands_vec)

# Make a lookup index for wetlands per site
wet_index <- hydro_data %>%
  arrange(Site, WetlandID) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  mutate(WetID = as.integer(factor(WetlandID, levels = unique(WetlandID)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>% select(Site, WetlandID, WetID) %>% distinct()

```

```{r}
# Canopy cover (% of tree veg)
can_pre <- habitat_data %>%
  filter(VegType == "tree") %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, CovPercent) %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID"))

canopy <- matrix(NA_real_, nSites, maxWetlands)
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  ss <- can_pre %>% filter(Site == site_levels[j])
  if (nrow(ss)) canopy[j, ss$WetID] <- ss$CovPercent
}

# Hydroperiod (0–12 proportion of months with water)
hyd_pre <- hydro_data %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, prop_water) %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID"))

hydro <- matrix(NA_real_, nSites, maxWetlands)
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  ss <- hyd_pre %>% filter(Site == site_levels[j])
  if (nrow(ss)) hydro[j, ss$WetID] <- as.numeric(ss$prop_water)
}

# Nearby wetlands (within 500 m)
near_pre <- wet_near_data %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, Count_500) %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID"))

nNearby_05 <- matrix(NA_real_, nSites, maxWetlands)
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  ss <- near_pre %>% filter(Site == site_levels[j])
  if (nrow(ss)) nNearby_05[j, ss$WetID] <- ss$Count_500
}

# ----- Ratio covariate (observed only at Ceylon) -----
# Make sure the column names match your CSV (adjust 'ratio_b_to_f_1' if needed)
ratio_pre <- ratio_data %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, ratio_b_to_f_1) %>%    # <- check this name in your CSV
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID"))

# Fill matrix with NA where unavailable
ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nSites, maxWetlands)
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  ss <- ratio_pre %>% filter(Site == site_levels[j])
  if (nrow(ss)) ratio_mat[j, ss$WetID] <- as.numeric(ss$ratio_b_to_f_1)
}

# Indicator of availability (1 = observed at this site/wetland, 0 = missing)
ratio_obs <- ifelse(is.na(ratio_mat), 0L, 1L)

# Build ratio_mat exactly as you do now...
# Compute mean/sd from observed (i.e., non-NA) entries (these will all be Ceylon)
ratio_vec_obs <- as.numeric(ratio_mat[!is.na(ratio_mat)])
ratio_mean <- mean(ratio_vec_obs)       # Ceylon-only
ratio_sd   <- sd(ratio_vec_obs); if (is.na(ratio_sd) || ratio_sd == 0) ratio_sd <- 1
ratio_sc <- (ratio_mat - ratio_mean) / ratio_sd
ratio_sc0 <- ratio_sc; ratio_sc0[is.na(ratio_sc0)] <- 0


# Safe scaling helper
safe_scale_mat <- function(M) {
  apply(M, 2, function(x) {
    s <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE); m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(s) || s == 0) ifelse(is.na(x), NA, 0) else (x - m)/s
  })
}

canopy_sc    <- safe_scale_mat(canopy)
hydro_sc     <- safe_scale_mat(hydro)
nNearby_sc   <- safe_scale_mat(nNearby_05)


```

```{r}
## ================================
## Arrays (site × wetland × month × year)
## ================================
effort_dip  <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))
effort_call <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))
effort_egg  <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))

y_dip   <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))
y_call  <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))
y_egg   <- array(0L, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nMonths, nYear))

## ================================
## DIP: effort & detections (collapsed to one cell per month)
## ================================
# Required: dip_data$Detected is 0/1
stopifnot("Detected" %in% names(dip_data))

dip_use <- dip_data %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID")) %>%
  mutate(
    site_j = as.integer(factor(Site, levels = site_levels)),
    mon_k  = as.integer(Month),           # Month already factor(month.name)
    yr_t   = YearIndex,                   # 1..nYear
    det    = as.integer(Detected > 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site_j), !is.na(WetID), !is.na(mon_k), mon_k >= 1, mon_k <= 12,
         !is.na(yr_t), yr_t >= 1, yr_t <= nYear) %>%
  group_by(site_j, WetID, mon_k, yr_t) %>%
  summarise(
    effort = 1L,                          # any visit that month = effort
    y      = as.integer(any(det == 1L)),  # detection if any visit detected
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(dip_use)) {
  idx <- as.matrix(dip_use[, c("site_j","WetID","mon_k","yr_t")])
  effort_dip[idx] <- 1L
  y_dip[idx]      <- dip_use$y
}

cat("DIP  | effort cells:", sum(effort_dip), " detections:", sum(y_dip), "\n")
stopifnot(all(y_dip <= effort_dip))

## ================================
## CALL: effort & detections (analyzed files only; collapsed to month)
## ================================
# Required: call_data$Detected is 0/1 (you created from Call_Score)
stopifnot("Detected" %in% names(call_data))

call_use <- call_data %>%
  filter(!(is.na(Listener) | Listener == "")) %>%     # only analyzed files
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID")) %>%
  mutate(
    site_j = as.integer(factor(Site, levels = site_levels)),
    mon_k  = as.integer(Month),
    yr_t   = YearIndex,
    det    = as.integer(Detected > 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site_j), !is.na(WetID), !is.na(mon_k), mon_k >= 1, mon_k <= 12,
         !is.na(yr_t), yr_t >= 1, yr_t <= nYear) %>%
  group_by(site_j, WetID, mon_k, yr_t) %>%
  summarise(
    effort = 1L,                          # any analyzed file that month
    y      = as.integer(any(det == 1L)),  # detection if any analyzed file detected
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(call_use)) {
  idx <- as.matrix(call_use[, c("site_j","WetID","mon_k","yr_t")])
  effort_call[idx] <- 1L
  y_call[idx]      <- call_use$y
}

cat("CALL | effort cells:", sum(effort_call), " detections:", sum(y_call), "\n")
stopifnot(all(y_call <= effort_call))

## ================================
## EGG: effort & detections (collapsed to month)
## ================================
# Required: egg_data$Detected is 0/1
## ================================
## EGG: effort & detections (collapsed to month)
## ================================
stopifnot("Detected" %in% names(egg_data))

egg_data_clean <- egg_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(wetlandid), wetlandid != 10) %>%
  mutate(
    wetlandid = as.character(wetlandid),
    wetlandid = stringr::str_replace(wetlandid, "\\.0+$", ""),
    wetlandid = stringr::str_trim(wetlandid)
  )

egg_use <- egg_data_clean %>%
  rename(Site = site, WetlandID = wetlandid, Year = year) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = if (is.numeric(month)) factor(
               month.name[pmax(1, pmin(12, as.integer(month)))],
               levels = month.name
            ) else factor(stringr::str_to_title(month), levels = month.name),
    Year  = as.integer(Year)
  ) %>%
  inner_join(wet_index, by = c("Site","WetlandID")) %>%
  mutate(
    site_j = as.integer(factor(Site, levels = site_levels)),
    mon_k  = as.integer(Month),
    yr_t   = match(Year, all_years),
    det    = as.integer(Detected > 0)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(site_j), !is.na(WetID), !is.na(mon_k), mon_k >= 1, mon_k <= 12,
         !is.na(yr_t), yr_t >= 1, yr_t <= nYear) %>%
  group_by(site_j, WetID, mon_k, yr_t) %>%
  summarise(
    effort = 1L,
    y      = as.integer(any(det == 1L)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


if (nrow(egg_use)) {
  idx <- as.matrix(egg_use[, c("site_j","WetID","mon_k","yr_t")])
  effort_egg[idx] <- 1L
  y_egg[idx]      <- egg_use$y
}

cat("EGG  | effort cells:", sum(effort_egg), " detections:", sum(y_egg), "\n")
stopifnot(all(y_egg <= effort_egg))

## ================================
## Global sanity
## ================================
stopifnot(all(y_dip  <= effort_dip),
          all(y_call <= effort_call),
          all(y_egg  <= effort_egg))

```


```{r}
site_jones <- c(0L, 1L) 

# Replace remaining NAs in covariates with 0 (post-scaling)
cov_na_to0 <- function(M) { M[is.na(M)] <- 0; M }
canopy_sc  <- cov_na_to0(canopy_sc)
hydro_sc   <- cov_na_to0(hydro_sc)
nNearby_sc <- cov_na_to0(nNearby_sc)

year_num <- as.numeric(all_years)        # e.g., c(2022, 2023, 2024)
year_c   <- year_num - mean(year_num)    # centered (no scaling)
# or: year_c <- as.numeric(scale(year_num, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))




data_list <- list(
  nSites = nSites,
  nMonths = nMonths,
  nYear  = nYear,
  nWetlands = nWetlands_vec,
  maxWetlands = maxWetlands,
  site_jones = site_jones,
  canopy = canopy_sc,
  hydro  = hydro_sc,
  dist   = nNearby_sc,
  ratio  = ratio_sc0,     # scaled, with NAs replaced by 0
  ratio_obs = ratio_obs,  # 0/1 mask of availability
  y_dip = y_dip,
  y_call = y_call,
  y_egg  = y_egg,
  effort_dip  = effort_dip,
  effort_call = effort_call,
  effort_egg  = effort_egg,
  year = year_c
)


```

```{r}
cat(file = "licap_occ_simple.jags", '
model{

  # Priors
  alpha0        ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_canopy  ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_hydro   ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_dist    ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_ratio   ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  alpha_land ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)



  beta0_dip  ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  beta0_call ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
  beta0_egg  ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)   # NEW

  # Month random-effect precisions (year will be fixed/non-pooled)
  pr_mon_dip  ~ dexp(1)
  pr_mon_call ~ dexp(1)
  pr_mon_egg  ~ dexp(1)


  for(m in 1:nMonths){
    beta_mon_dip[m]  ~ dnorm(0, pr_mon_dip)
    beta_mon_call[m] ~ dnorm(0, pr_mon_call)
    beta_mon_egg[m]  ~ dnorm(0, pr_mon_egg)
  }


beta_yr_dip  ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
beta_yr_call ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)
beta_yr_egg  ~ dnorm(0, 0.5)



  # Ecological & observation processes (single species)
  for(j in 1:nSites){
    for(w in 1:nWetlands[j]){
      for(t in 1:nYear){

logit(psi[j,w,t]) <- alpha0
                    + alpha_land * site_jones[j]
                    + alpha_canopy * canopy[j,w]
                    + alpha_hydro  * hydro[j,w]
                    + alpha_dist   * dist[j,w]
                    + alpha_ratio  * ratio[j,w] * ratio_obs[j,w]

        z[j,w,t] ~ dbern(psi[j,w,t])

        for(m in 1:nMonths){
          logit(p_dip[j,w,m,t])  <- beta0_dip  + beta_mon_dip[m]  + beta_yr_dip * year[t]
          logit(p_call[j,w,m,t]) <- beta0_call + beta_mon_call[m] + beta_yr_call * year[t]
          logit(p_egg[j,w,m,t])  <- beta0_egg  + beta_mon_egg[m]  + beta_yr_egg * year[t]  # NEW

          y_dip[j,w,m,t]  ~ dbern(z[j,w,t] * p_dip[j,w,m,t]  * effort_dip[j,w,m,t])
          y_call[j,w,m,t] ~ dbern(z[j,w,t] * p_call[j,w,m,t] * effort_call[j,w,m,t])
          y_egg[j,w,m,t]  ~ dbern(z[j,w,t] * p_egg[j,w,m,t]  * effort_egg[j,w,m,t])  # NEW
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # Derived: site-year occupancy proportion
  for(j in 1:nSites){
    for(t in 1:nYear){
      occ_count[j,t] <- sum(z[j,1:nWetlands[j],t])
      occ_prop[j,t]  <- occ_count[j,t] / nWetlands[j]
    }
  }
}
')

```

```{r}
# z inits from detections (now include egg too)
z_init <- array(NA, dim = c(nSites, maxWetlands, nYear))
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  for (w in seq_len(nWetlands_vec[j])) {
    for (t in seq_len(nYear)) {
      any_det <- any(y_dip[j,w,,t] == 1) || any(y_call[j,w,,t] == 1) || any(y_egg[j,w,,t] == 1)  # NEW
      z_init[j,w,t] <- ifelse(any_det, 1L, rbinom(1,1,0.5))
    }
  }
}

inits_fun <- function(){
  list(
    z = z_init,
    alpha0 = 0,
    alpha_canopy = 0,
    alpha_hydro  = 0,
    alpha_dist   = 0,
    alpha_ratio  = 0,
    alpha_land = 0,
    beta0_dip = 0, beta0_call = 0, beta0_egg = 0  # NEW
  )
}

params <- c(
  "alpha0","alpha_canopy","alpha_hydro","alpha_dist","alpha_ratio",
  "alpha_land",
  "beta0_dip","beta0_call","beta0_egg",                 # NEW
  "beta_mon_dip","beta_mon_call","beta_mon_egg",        # NEW
  "beta_yr_dip","beta_yr_call","beta_yr_egg",           # NEW
  "occ_prop","psi","z"
)

fit <- jagsUI::jags(
  data = data_list,
  inits = inits_fun,
  parameters.to.save = params,
  model.file = "licap_occ_simple.jags",
  n.chains = 3, n.iter = 50000, n.burnin = 15000, n.thin = 5, parallel = TRUE
)

print(fit, digits = 3)


```
```{r}
# ---- Extract posterior means and save ----

# psi is [site, wetland, year] in the model; sims.list adds MCMC-iters as dim 1
stopifnot(!is.null(fit$sims.list$psi), !is.null(fit$sims.list$z))

# Posterior mean occupancy probability from psi
psi_post <- apply(fit$sims.list$psi, c(2, 3, 4), mean)  # dims: [nSites, maxWetlands, nYear]

# Posterior mean of latent z (≈ occupancy probability via the latent state)
z_post <- apply(fit$sims.list$z,   c(2, 3, 4), mean)    # dims: [nSites, maxWetlands, nYear]

# (Optional) nice dimnames for readability
dimnames(psi_post) <- list(
  Site = as.character(site_levels),
  WetID = paste0("W", seq_len(maxWetlands)),
  Year = as.character(all_years)
)
dimnames(z_post) <- dimnames(psi_post)

# Also useful: site-year occupancy proportion (you already monitor occ_prop[j,t])
occ_prop_post <- apply(fit$sims.list$occ_prop, c(2, 3), mean)  # [nSites, nYear]
dimnames(occ_prop_post) <- list(Site = as.character(site_levels),
                                Year = as.character(all_years))

# Save
saveRDS(psi_post, file = "psi_post_mean.rds")
saveRDS(z_post,   file = "z_post_mean.rds")
saveRDS(occ_prop_post, file = "occ_prop_post_mean.rds")

# (Optional) tidy data frames you can View / export
# Map WetID -> WetlandID for each Site
wet_key <- wet_index %>% dplyr::select(Site, WetID, WetlandID)

psi_df <- as.data.frame.table(psi_post, responseName = "psi_mean") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(WetID = as.integer(sub("^W", "", WetID))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(wet_key, by = c("Site", "WetID")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Site, WetlandID, Year, psi_mean)

z_df <- as.data.frame.table(z_post, responseName = "z_mean") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(WetID = as.integer(sub("^W", "", WetID))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(wet_key, by = c("Site", "WetID")) %>%

saveRDS(psi_post, file = "psi_post_mean.rds")
saveRDS(z_post,   file = "z_post_mean.rds")
```

```{r}

library(coda)

## 0) Your simple flags (unchanged)
sumtab   <- fit$summary
bad_rhat <- rownames(sumtab)[sumtab[,"Rhat"]  > 1.01]
low_neff <- rownames(sumtab)[sumtab[,"n.eff"] < 400]
bad_rhat <- bad_rhat[!is.na(bad_rhat)]
low_neff <- low_neff[!is.na(low_neff)]
to_check <- unique(c(bad_rhat, low_neff))

## 1) Get an mcmc.list no matter how jagsUI stored things
get_mcmc_list <- function(fit) {
  # Preferred locations
  if (!is.null(fit$mcmc) && inherits(fit$mcmc, "mcmc.list")) return(fit$mcmc)
  if (!is.null(fit$samples) && inherits(fit$samples, "mcmc.list")) return(fit$samples)
  # R2jags-style (sometimes present even under jagsUI)
  if (!is.null(fit$BUGSoutput) && !is.null(fit$BUGSoutput$sims.array)) {
    sa <- fit$BUGSoutput$sims.array  # dims: iter x chains x params
    par_names <- dimnames(sa)[[3]]
    iters <- dim(sa)[1]; chains <- dim(sa)[2]; pars <- dim(sa)[3]
    return(mcmc.list(lapply(seq_len(chains), function(ch) {
      mat <- matrix(sa[, ch, ], nrow = iters, ncol = pars)
      colnames(mat) <- par_names
      mcmc(mat)
    })))
  }
  # Last resort: try to build a single-chain object from sims.list (no GR possible)
  if (!is.null(fit$sims.list)) {
    # flatten sims.list into a matrix of draws (combined chains) -> single mcmc
    sl <- fit$sims.list
    cols <- names(sl)
    mat <- cbind.data.frame(lapply(sl, as.numeric))
    mat <- as.matrix(mat)
    colnames(mat) <- cols
    return(mcmc.list(mcmc(mat)))  # single chain
  }
  stop("No MCMC draws found in fit.")
}

mlist <- get_mcmc_list(fit)
n_ch   <- length(mlist)

## 2) Keep only flagged parameters that actually exist
avail <- colnames(as.matrix(mlist[[1]]))
keep  <- intersect(to_check, avail)

if (!length(keep)) {
  message("Flags found but none were monitored. Available example vars: ",
          paste(head(avail, 10), collapse = ", "))
} else {
  mlist_keep <- mcmc.list(lapply(mlist, function(ch) ch[, keep, drop = FALSE]))

  ## 3) Trace plots (works for any number of chains)
  pdf("trace_problem_params.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 11)
  step <- 24
  for (i in seq(1, length(keep), by = step)) {
    idx <- i:min(i + step - 1, length(keep))
    traceplot(mlist_keep[, keep[idx], drop = FALSE])
  }
  dev.off()

  ## 4) Gelman–Rubin ONLY if we actually have ≥ 2 chains
  if (n_ch >= 2) {
    gr  <- gelman.diag(mlist_keep, autoburnin = FALSE, multivariate = FALSE)
    print(gr)
  } else {
    message("Only one chain available; Gelman–Rubin requires ≥ 2 chains. ",
            "Using Rhat from fit$summary instead.")
  }

  ## 5) Effective sample sizes (always useful)
  ess <- effectiveSize(mlist_keep)
  print(sort(ess)[1:min(25, length(ess))])

  ## 6) Save a tidy CSV (Rhat from your summary, ESS from chains)
  out <- data.frame(
    param = keep,
    Rhat  = sumtab[keep, "Rhat"],
    ESS   = as.numeric(ess[keep]),
    row.names = NULL
  )
  write.csv(out, "convergence_flags_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  out
}
```

```{r}
# Helper: get posteriors for β_year * each year_c[t] for one method
expand_year_post <- function(beta_draws, year_vec, year_labels, method_label){
  out <- lapply(seq_along(year_vec), function(t){
    data.frame(
      Estimate = beta_draws * year_vec[t],
      Year = year_labels[t],
      Method = method_label
    )
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

# Build long data for all methods
post_year_long <- bind_rows(
  expand_year_post(s$beta_yr_call, year_c, year_labels, "Call Files"),
  expand_year_post(s$beta_yr_dip,  year_c, year_labels, "Dipnet Surveys"),
  if (!is.null(s$beta_yr_egg))
    expand_year_post(s$beta_yr_egg, year_c, year_labels, "Egg Mass Surveys")
)
```

```{r}
# --- ψ violins by wetland, OVERALL across all years (equal-weight), with median + 80/95% CIs ---

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

stopifnot(!is.null(fit$sims.list$psi))  # dims: [iter, site, wetland, year]
psi_all <- fit$sims.list$psi

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

stopifnot(!is.null(fit$sims.list$psi))  # psi dims: [iter, site, wetland, year]
psi_all <- fit$sims.list$psi
dims <- dim(psi_all)
n_iter <- dims[1]

# --- 1) Mean ψ over years per draw, computed slice-by-slice (robust) ---
psi_draws_overall <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_iter, nSites, maxWetlands))

for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  for (w in seq_len(nWetlands_vec[j])) {
    # slice for this site/wetland across all years at once
    sl <- psi_all[, j, w, , drop = TRUE]
    # if only one year, `sl` is a vector; otherwise a matrix [iter x nYear]
    v <- if (is.null(dim(sl))) as.numeric(sl) else rowMeans(sl, na.rm = TRUE)
    # sanitize: drop non-finite, clamp to [0,1]
    v[!is.finite(v)] <- NA_real_
    v <- pmin(pmax(v, 0), 1)
    psi_draws_overall[, j, w] <- v
  }
}

# 2) Map WetID -> WetlandID (for ordering/labels)
wet_key <- wet_index %>% dplyr::select(Site, WetID, WetlandID)

# 3) Summaries per wetland (over draws of the year-averaged ψ)
rows <- list(); k <- 0L
for (j in seq_len(nSites)) {
  for (w in seq_len(nWetlands_vec[j])) {
    v <- psi_draws_overall[, j, w]
    v <- v[is.finite(v)]
    k <- k + 1L
    if (length(v)) {
      qs <- stats::quantile(v, probs = c(0.025, 0.10, 0.20, 0.50, 0.80, 0.90, 0.975))
      rows[[k]] <- data.frame(
        Site       = as.character(site_levels[j]),
        WetID      = w,
        lo95 = qs[1], lo90 = qs[2], lo80 = qs[3],
        med  = mean(v),
        hi80 = qs[5], hi90 = qs[6], hi95 = qs[7],
        pr_gt_0.5  = mean(v > 0.5)
      )
    } else {
      # no valid draws for this wetland (keeps alignment; will be dropped later)
      rows[[k]] <- data.frame(
        Site = as.character(site_levels[j]), WetID = w,
        lo95 = NA, lo90 = NA, lo80 = NA, med = NA, hi80 = NA, hi90 = NA, hi95 = NA,
        pr_gt_0.5 = NA
      )
    }
  }
}

psi_wet_overall <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(wet_key, by = c("Site","WetID")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    WetlandID_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(WetlandID)),
    WetlandID_f   = {
      ord <- ifelse(is.na(WetlandID_num), WetID, WetlandID_num)
      factor(ifelse(is.na(WetlandID), paste0("W", WetID), WetlandID),
             levels = unique(ifelse(is.na(WetlandID),
                                    paste0("W", WetID),
                                    as.character(WetlandID))[order(ord)]))
    },
    predicted_occupied = med >= 0.5
  )

# 4) Long draws for violins, sanitized & (optionally) downsampled
downsample_n <- 4000L
make_long_one <- function(j, w) {
  v <- psi_draws_overall[, j, w]
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (!length(v)) return(data.frame(Site = as.character(site_levels[j]),
                                    WetID = w, psi = numeric(0)))
  if (!is.na(downsample_n) && length(v) > downsample_n) {
    set.seed(42); v <- sample(v, downsample_n)
  }
  data.frame(Site = as.character(site_levels[j]), WetID = w, psi = v)
}

psi_long_overall <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nSites), function(j) {
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nWetlands_vec[j]), function(w) make_long_one(j, w))
}) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    psi_wet_overall %>% dplyr::select(Site, WetID, WetlandID, WetlandID_f, predicted_occupied),
    by = c("Site","WetID")
  )
# --- DIAGNOSTIC: which plotted labels correspond to actual detections? ---

# 1) any detection by wetland (across all months/years), from the arrays you already have
any_det <- (y_dip + y_call + y_egg) > 0  # dims: [site, wet, month, year]
det_by_wet <- lapply(seq_len(nSites), function(j) {
  if (nWetlands_vec[j] == 0) return(dplyr::tibble())
  has_det <- apply(any_det[j, 1:nWetlands_vec[j], , , drop = FALSE], 2, any)
  dplyr::tibble(Site = as.character(site_levels[j]),
                WetID = seq_len(nWetlands_vec[j]),
                any_det = as.logical(has_det))
}) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

# 2) join to psi summaries + labels used in the plot
psi_wet_overall <- psi_wet_overall |>
  dplyr::left_join(det_by_wet, by = c("Site","WetID")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(any_det = dplyr::coalesce(any_det, FALSE))

# 3) sanity table for YOUR list
your_list <- list(
  "Ceylon WMA" = c("41","41B","59"),
  "Jones Center Ichauway" = c("15","21","37","42","46","49","50","51","53","55")
)
check_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(your_list), function(s) {
  dplyr::tibble(Site = s, WetlandID = your_list[[s]])
})) |>
  dplyr::left_join(psi_wet_overall, by = c("Site","WetlandID")) |>
  dplyr::select(Site, WetlandID, WetID, any_det, med, lo80, hi80)

print(check_tbl, n = Inf)

# 5) Plot (tell geoms to ignore any leftover NAs)
p_psi_violin_overall <- ggplot(psi_long_overall, aes(x = WetlandID_f, y = psi)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = predicted_occupied), trim = FALSE, scale = "width",
              width = 0.85, colour = "grey35", alpha = 0.85, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_linerange(data = psi_wet_overall, aes(x = WetlandID_f, ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95),
                 linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.25, inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_linerange(data = psi_wet_overall, aes(x = WetlandID_f, ymin = lo80, ymax = hi80),
                 linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.6, inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
   
  geom_point(data = psi_wet_overall, aes(x = WetlandID_f, y = med),
             size = 2.2, colour = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1f78b4", `FALSE` = "grey70"),
                    name = "Predicted occupied\n(overall median ψ ≥ 0.5)") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)),
                     name = expression("Occupancy Probability"(psi))) +
  labs(x = "Wetland ID",
       title = "Predicted Occupancy Probability of Gopher Frogs by Wetland (ψ)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.2, "lines"))

print(p_psi_violin_overall)
ggsave("psi_posterior_violins_by_wetland_overall.png",
       p_psi_violin_overall, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

# Optional: quick report so you can see if any wetlands had zero valid draws
bad_wets <- psi_long_overall %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Site, WetID, WetlandID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_draws = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%

if (nrow(bad_wets)) {
```

```{r}
# --- Overall ψ maps by site, with shifted viridis palette ---

library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(maptiles)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)

# 1) Build OVERALL ψ per wetland (equal-weight across years)
stopifnot(!is.null(fit$sims.list$psi))  # dims: [iter, site, wetland, year]
psi_all <- fit$sims.list$psi

# Average across the year dimension inside each draw -> [iter, site, wetland]
psi_draws_overall <- apply(psi_all, c(1, 2, 3), mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Summarize per site/wetland
summ_overall <- lapply(seq_len(nSites), function(j){
  lapply(seq_len(nWetlands_vec[j]), function(w){
    v  <- psi_draws_overall[, j, w]
    qs <- stats::quantile(v, c(0.025,0.10,0.20,0.50,0.80,0.90,0.975), na.rm=TRUE)
    data.frame(Site = as.character(site_levels[j]), WetID = w,
               lo95 = qs[1], lo90 = qs[2], lo80 = qs[3],
               med  = qs[4],
               hi80 = qs[5], hi90 = qs[6], hi95 = qs[7],
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }) |> bind_rows()
}) |> bind_rows()

wet_key <- wet_index %>% select(Site, WetID, WetlandID)
psi_wet_overall <- summ_overall %>%
  left_join(wet_key, by = c("Site","WetID")) %>%
  mutate(WetlandID = as.character(WetlandID))

s_wet <- psi_wet_overall %>%
  select(Site, WetlandID, med) %>%
  mutate(WetlandID = as.character(WetlandID))

# Canonicalize IDs
canon_id <- function(x) as.character(x) |> str_trim() |> str_replace("\\.0+$","") |> toupper()

prob_col <- intersect(c("Pocc","med","z_mean","psi_mean","psi","p"), names(s_wet))[1]
stopifnot(length(prob_col) == 1)

sw <- s_wet %>%
  mutate(
    Site = recode(as.character(Site),
                  "Ceylon" = "Ceylon WMA",
                  "Jones Center" = "Jones Center Ichauway",
                  .default = as.character(Site)),
    WetlandID = canon_id(WetlandID),
    Pocc = pmin(pmax(.data[[prob_col]], 0), 1)   # overall ψ (median)
  ) %>% select(Site, WetlandID, Pocc)

# 2) Read wetlands and boundaries
ceylon_study <- st_read("ceylon_wetlands_subset.shp", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(WetlandID = canon_id(WetlandID), Site = "Ceylon WMA")
jones_study  <- st_read("jones_study_wetlands.shp", quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(WetlandID = canon_id(WetlandID), Site = "Jones Center Ichauway")

cey_boundary <- st_read("ceylon_boundary.shp", quiet = TRUE)
if ("NAME" %in% names(cey_boundary)) {
  cey_boundary <- cey_boundary %>% filter(toupper(NAME) == "CEYLON WMA")
} else if ("Name" %in% names(cey_boundary)) {
  cey_boundary <- cey_boundary %>% filter(toupper(Name) == "CEYLON WMA")
}
jon_boundary <- st_read("jones_land.shp", quiet = TRUE)

# Dissolve to single outline
dissolve_boundary <- function(x){
  x |> st_make_valid() |> mutate(.grp = 1L) |> group_by(.grp) |>
    summarise(geometry = st_union(geometry), .groups="drop") |> select(-.grp)
}
cey_boundary_d <- dissolve_boundary(cey_boundary)
jon_boundary_d <- dissolve_boundary(jon_boundary)

# Join wetlands with ψ
cey_poly_p <- ceylon_study %>% left_join(filter(sw, Site=="Ceylon WMA"), by="WetlandID")
jon_poly_p <- jones_study  %>% left_join(filter(sw, Site=="Jones Center Ichauway"), by="WetlandID")

# 3) Mapping function with shifted viridis
site_satellite_map <- function(boundary_sf, wetlands_sf, title_txt,
                               provider="Esri.WorldImagery", zoom=16,
                               legend_title=expression(psi~"(occupancy)")) {
  r <- maptiles::get_tiles(boundary_sf, provider=provider, zoom=zoom,
                           crop=TRUE, cachedir="tile-cache")
  wm_crs <- st_crs(terra::crs(r, proj=TRUE))
  boundary_wm <- st_transform(boundary_sf, wm_crs)
  wetlands_wm <- st_transform(wetlands_sf, wm_crs)
  r <- terra::mask(r, terra::vect(boundary_wm))
  
  ggplot() +
 
    tidyterra::geom_spatraster_rgb(data = r) +
    # filled wetlands WITH white outline
    geom_sf(data = dplyr::filter(wetlands_wm, !is.na(Pocc)),
            aes(fill = Pocc), color = "white", size = 0.05) +
    # wetlands with no Pocc still get a white outline
    geom_sf(data = dplyr::filter(wetlands_wm,  is.na(Pocc)),
            fill = "grey80", color = "white", size = 0.05) +
    # site boundary
    geom_sf(data = boundary_wm, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1.1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(0,1),
                         begin = 0.15, end = 1,   # shifted away from dark purple
                         name = legend_title, na.value = "grey90") +

    labs(title=title_txt, x=NULL, y=NULL) +
    coord_sf(expand=FALSE, crs=wm_crs, datum=NA) +
    theme_void(base_size=12) +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)), 
  plot.title.position = "plot",   # moves the title relative to the entire plot area
  legend.position = "right",
  plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 15, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)  # extra padding around the plot
)

}

# 4) Draw maps
dir.create("tile-cache", showWarnings=FALSE)
p_ceylon <- site_satellite_map(cey_boundary_d, cey_poly_p, "Occupancy Probability — Ceylon WMA")
p_jones  <- site_satellite_map(jon_boundary_d,  jon_poly_p, "Occupancy Probability — Jones Center Ichauway")

print(p_ceylon)
print(p_jones)
# Save Ceylon map
ggsave("occupancy_ceylon.png", p_ceylon,
       width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Save Jones map
ggsave("occupancy_jones.png", p_jones,
       width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Helper to sum valid wetlands for a site
sum_site <- function(Y, j) {
  if (nWetlands_vec[j] == 0) return(0L)
  sum(Y[j, 1:nWetlands_vec[j], , , drop = FALSE])
}

# 0) Totals by method and overall (month-collapsed detections)

total_call <- sum(y_call)
total_egg  <- sum(y_egg)

  Method = c("Dipnet", "Call files", "Egg masses", "ALL METHODS"),
  Detections = c(total_dip, total_call, total_egg, total_all)
)

# 1) Per-site totals by method (sums of month-collapsed detections)
per_site_method <- map_dfr(seq_len(nSites), function(j){

    Site = as.character(site_levels[j]),

    Call_files = sum_site(y_call, j),
    Egg_masses = sum_site(y_egg,  j)
```

```{r}
# --- Time summaries of detections by site / year / month (from arrays) ---

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

# Helper to turn an array into a long tibble
# y/eff dims: [site, wetland, month, year]
arr_to_df <- function(y, eff, method_name){
  stopifnot(length(dim(y)) == 4, all(dim(y) == dim(eff)))

  y_tbl   <- as.data.frame.table(y,   responseName = "det")
  eff_tbl <- as.data.frame.table(eff, responseName = "eff")

  df <- y_tbl %>%
    rename(Var1y = Var1, Var2y = Var2, Var3y = Var3, Var4y = Var4) %>%
    bind_cols(eff_tbl %>% select(eff)) %>%     # align row-for-row
    mutate(
      # convert factor indices to integer positions 1..n
      site_i = as.integer(Var1y),
      wet_i  = as.integer(Var2y),
      mon_i  = as.integer(Var3y),
      yr_i   = as.integer(Var4y),
      det    = as.integer(det),
      eff    = as.integer(eff)
    ) %>%
    # keep only surveyed cells
    filter(eff > 0L) %>%
    # drop padding wetlands beyond the real count at that site
    group_by(site_i) %>%
    filter(wet_i <= nWetlands_vec[site_i]) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Site   = as.character(site_levels[site_i]),
      Year   = all_years[yr_i],
      MonthI = mon_i,
      Month  = factor(month.name[MonthI], levels = month.name),
      Method = method_name
    ) %>%
    select(Site, Year, Month, MonthI, Method, WetID = wet_i, det, eff)

  df
}


df_call <- arr_to_df(y_call, effort_call, "Call")
df_dip  <- arr_to_df(y_dip,  effort_dip,  "Dip")
df_egg  <- arr_to_df(y_egg,  effort_egg,  "Egg")

# Bind all methods
df_all <- bind_rows(df_call, df_dip, df_egg)

# -----------------------------
# A) Years with any detection
# -----------------------------
years_with_detection_by_site_method <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Site, Method, Year) %>%
  summarise(any_det = any(det == 1L), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_det) %>%
  group_by(Site, Method) %>%
  summarise(Years = paste(sort(unique(Year)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Site, Method)

# Overall (any method)
years_with_detection_overall <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Site, Year) %>%
  summarise(any_det = any(det == 1L), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_det) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  summarise(Years = paste(sort(unique(Year)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "Any method") %>%
  select(Site, Method, Years)

# -----------------------------
# B) Months with any detection (across all years)
# -----------------------------
months_with_detection_by_site_method <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Site, Method, Month, MonthI) %>%
  summarise(any_det = any(det == 1L), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_det) %>%
  group_by(Site, Method) %>%
  arrange(MonthI, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(Months = paste(as.character(Month), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Site, Method)

months_with_detection_overall <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Site, Month, MonthI) %>%
  summarise(any_det = any(det == 1L), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_det) %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  arrange(MonthI, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(Months = paste(as.character(Month), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "Any method") %>%
  select(Site, Method, Months)

# -----------------------------
# C) Site × Year × Month table: detection counts & effort
#     - det_cells = # wetland-month cells with detection (1)
#     - n_cells   = # surveyed wetland-month cells (effort > 0)
# -----------------------------
site_year_month_by_method <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Site, Method, Year, Month, MonthI) %>%
  summarise(
    det_cells = sum(det, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cells   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Site, Method, Year, MonthI)

site_year_month_overall <- df_all %>%
  group_by(Site, Year, Month, MonthI) %>%
  summarise(
    det_cells = sum(det, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cells   = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Method = "Any method") %>%
  arrange(Site, Year, MonthI)

# -----------------------------
# Pretty prints
# -----------------------------
cat("\n=== YEARS WITH ANY DETECTION — by Site & Method ===\n")
print(years_with_detection_by_site_method, n = Inf)

cat("\n=== YEARS WITH ANY DETECTION — Overall (Any method) ===\n")
print(years_with_detection_overall, n = Inf)

cat("\n=== MONTHS WITH ANY DETECTION (across all years) — by Site & Method ===\n")
print(months_with_detection_by_site_method, n = Inf)

cat("\n=== MONTHS WITH ANY DETECTION (across all years) — Overall (Any method) ===\n")
print(months_with_detection_overall, n = Inf)

cat("\n=== SITE × YEAR × MONTH — detection cells & surveyed cells (by method) ===\n")
print(site_year_month_by_method %>% select(Site, Method, Year, Month, det_cells, n_cells), n = 30)

cat("\n=== SITE × YEAR × MONTH — detection cells & surveyed cells (overall) ===\n")
print(site_year_month_overall %>% select(Site, Year, Month, det_cells, n_cells), n = 30)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Occupancy & Detection: tables for thesis / appendix
# (NO file writes)
# Requires: fit, y_* / effort_* arrays, site_levels, all_years,
#           nSites, nWetlands_vec, wet_index
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

inv_logit <- function(x) 1/(1+exp(-x))
s <- fit$sims.list

# Helper: proportion of draws whose sign matches the mean's sign
pr_same_sign <- function(v){
  m <- mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(m) || m == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(sign(v) == sign(m), na.rm = TRUE)
}
# ---- implied per-year effects from the scalar slope β_year ----
stopifnot(exists("year_c"), exists("all_years"))
by_call <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_call), year_c)  # [draw] x [year]
by_dip  <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_dip ), year_c)
by_egg  <- if (!is.null(s$beta_yr_egg)) outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_egg), year_c) else NULL
colnames(by_call) <- colnames(by_dip) <- as.character(all_years)
if (!is.null(by_egg)) colnames(by_egg) <- as.character(all_years)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Naïve occupancy (per site + overall)
#    (fraction of wetlands with ≥1 detection, any method)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
any_det_arr <- (y_dip + y_call + y_egg) > 0  # [site, wet, month, year]

naive_by_site <- lapply(seq_len(nSites), function(j){
  if (nWetlands_vec[j] == 0) return(tibble())
  any_wet <- apply(any_det_arr[j, 1:nWetlands_vec[j], , , drop = FALSE], 2, any)
  tibble(Site = as.character(site_levels[j]),
         nWetlands = nWetlands_vec[j],
         nWithDet  = sum(any_wet),
         naive_occupancy = nWithDet / nWetlands)
}) |> bind_rows()

naive_overall <- tibble(
  Site = "Overall",
  nWetlands = sum(nWetlands_vec),
  nWithDet  = sum(naive_by_site$nWithDet),
  naive_occupancy = nWithDet / nWetlands
)

naive_tbl <- bind_rows(naive_by_site, naive_overall)
cat("\n=== Naïve occupancy (per site & overall) ===\n")
print(naive_tbl, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Occupancy probability at the site level (posterior)
#    Using monitored occ_prop[j,t] (site-year proportion occupied)
#    and an equal-weight average across years (within draw)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(!is.null(s$occ_prop))
occ <- s$occ_prop  # [iter, site, year]

# (a) Site × Year summaries (means instead of medians)
occ_by_site_year <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nSites), function(j){
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(dim(occ)[3]), function(t){
    v  <- occ[, j, t]
    qs <- quantile(v, c(.025,.975), na.rm=TRUE)
    tibble(Site = as.character(site_levels[j]),
           Year = as.character(all_years[t]),
           mean = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
           lo95 = qs[1], hi95 = qs[2],
           pr_gt_0.5 = mean(v > 0.5, na.rm=TRUE))
  }))
})) %>% arrange(Site, Year)

# (b) Overall by site (equal-weight across years within each draw)
occ_site_overall_draws <- apply(occ, c(1,2), mean, na.rm = TRUE)  # [iter, site]

calc_stats <- function(v){
  c(
    mean       = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo95       = quantile(v, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi95       = quantile(v, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    pr_gt_0.5  = mean(v > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# rows = sites, cols = stats (mean, lo95, hi95, pr_gt_0.5)
occ_site_summ <- t(apply(occ_site_overall_draws, 2, calc_stats))
occ_site_summ <- as.data.frame(occ_site_summ)
occ_site_summ[] <- lapply(occ_site_summ, function(x) as.numeric(x))

occ_site_overall_tbl <- dplyr::tibble(Site = as.character(site_levels)) |>
  dplyr::bind_cols(occ_site_summ)

cat("\n=== Site-level occupancy (overall across years) ===\n")
print(occ_site_overall_tbl)
cat("\n=== Site × Year occupancy ===\n")
print(occ_by_site_year, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Occupancy probability for each wetland (overall)
#    (numbers that correspond to your violins & maps)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
stopifnot(!is.null(s$psi))
psi_all <- s$psi  # [iter, site, wetland, year]

# average across years within draw -> [iter, site, wetland]
psi_overall_draws <- apply(psi_all, c(1,2,3), mean, na.rm=TRUE)

wet_key <- wet_index %>% select(Site, WetID, WetlandID)
psi_wet_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nSites), function(j){
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nWetlands_vec[j]), function(w){
    v <- psi_overall_draws[, j, w]
    qs <- quantile(v, c(.025,.10,.20,.80,.90,.975), na.rm=TRUE)
    tibble(Site = as.character(site_levels[j]),
           WetID = w,
           WetlandID = wet_key$WetlandID[wet_key$Site==as.character(site_levels[j]) & wet_key$WetID==w][1],
           mean = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
           lo80 = qs[3], hi80 = qs[4],
           lo95 = qs[1], hi95 = qs[6],
           pr_gt_0.5 = mean(v > 0.5, na.rm=TRUE))
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(WetlandID = as.character(WetlandID),
         WetlandID_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(WetlandID))) %>%
  arrange(Site, is.na(WetlandID_num), WetlandID_num, WetlandID) %>%
  select(-WetlandID_num)

cat("\n=== Wetland-level occupancy (overall across years) ===\n")
print(head(psi_wet_tbl, 20))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Relationships (occupancy): covariates & landscape REs
#    Report means, 95% CrIs on logit scale + Pr(same sign as mean)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
need <- c("alpha_canopy","alpha_hydro","alpha_dist","alpha_ratio","alpha_land")
stopifnot(all(need %in% names(s)))

summ_beta <- function(draws, name){
  tibble(Parameter = name,
         mean = mean(draws, na.rm = TRUE),
         lo95 = quantile(draws, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
         hi95 = quantile(draws, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
         pr_same_sign_as_mean = pr_same_sign(draws))
}

rel_all_tbl <- bind_rows(
  summ_beta(s$alpha_canopy, "Canopy (alpha_canopy)"),
  summ_beta(s$alpha_hydro,  "Hydroperiod (alpha_hydro)"),
  summ_beta(s$alpha_dist,   "Nearby ≤500 m (alpha_dist)"),
  summ_beta(s$alpha_ratio,  "Ratio (alpha_ratio)"),
  summ_beta(s$alpha_land,   "Landscape (Jones vs Ceylon, alpha_land)")  # NEW
)

cat("\n=== Occupancy relationships: fixed effects (logit scale) ===\n")
print(rel_all_tbl, n = Inf)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Detection probability — overall (model-based; no site split)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# implied per-year effects from the scalar slope β_year
stopifnot(exists("year_c"), exists("all_years"))
by_call <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_call), year_c)
by_dip  <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_dip ), year_c)
by_egg  <- if (!is.null(s$beta_yr_egg)) outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_egg), year_c) else NULL
colnames(by_call) <- colnames(by_dip) <- as.character(all_years)
if (!is.null(by_egg)) colnames(by_egg) <- as.character(all_years)

avg_over_month_year <- function(b0, bmon, byear){
  M  <- ncol(as.data.frame(bmon))
  TT <- ncol(as.data.frame(byear))
  rowMeans(do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(M), function(m)
    sapply(seq_len(TT), function(t) inv_logit(b0 + bmon[,m] + byear[,t])))), na.rm = TRUE)
}

p_call <- avg_over_month_year(s$beta0_call, s$beta_mon_call, by_call)
p_dip  <- avg_over_month_year(s$beta0_dip,  s$beta_mon_dip,  by_dip)
p_egg  <- if (!is.null(s$beta0_egg)) avg_over_month_year(s$beta0_egg, s$beta_mon_egg, by_egg) else NULL


summ_p <- function(v, name){
  qs <- quantile(v, c(.025,.975), na.rm=TRUE)
  tibble(Method = name, p_mean = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
         p_lo95 = qs[1], p_hi95 = qs[2])
}

det_overall_tbl <- bind_rows(
  summ_p(p_call, "Call files"),
  summ_p(p_dip,  "Dipnet surveys"),
  if (!is.null(p_egg)) summ_p(p_egg, "Egg mass surveys")
)
cat("\n=== Overall detection probability (model-based) ===\n")
print(det_overall_tbl)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) Detection relationships: Month & Year
#    (a) Effects on logit scale with Pr(same sign as mean)
#    (b) Marginal probabilities by month/year with 95% CrIs
# ------------------------------------------------------------
labs_for_months <- function(M) month.name[seq_len(ncol(as.data.frame(M)))]
labs_for_years  <- function(M) as.character(all_years)[seq_len(ncol(as.data.frame(M)))]

summ_effects_logit <- function(M, effect_name, labels_vec){
  L <- ncol(as.data.frame(M))
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(L), function(i){
    v  <- M[, i]
    tibble(Effect = effect_name, Level = labels_vec[i],
           mean = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
           lo95 = quantile(v, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
           hi95 = quantile(v, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
           pr_same_sign_as_mean = pr_same_sign(v))
  }))
}

# (a) logit-scale effects + Pr(same sign as mean)
month_fx_tbl <- bind_rows(
  summ_effects_logit(s$beta_mon_call, "Month (Call files)", labs_for_months(s$beta_mon_call)),
  summ_effects_logit(s$beta_mon_dip,  "Month (Dipnet)"    , labs_for_months(s$beta_mon_dip)),
  if (!is.null(s$beta_mon_egg))
    summ_effects_logit(s$beta_mon_egg, "Month (Egg)"      , labs_for_months(s$beta_mon_egg))
)
year_fx_tbl <- bind_rows(
  summ_effects_logit(by_call, "Year (Call files)", labs_for_years(by_call)),
  summ_effects_logit(by_dip,  "Year (Dipnet)"    , labs_for_years(by_dip)),
  if (!is.null(by_egg))
    summ_effects_logit(by_egg, "Year (Egg)"      , labs_for_years(by_egg))
)


cat("\n=== Detection effects — logit scale (Month & Year) ===\n")
print(head(month_fx_tbl, 12)); print(head(year_fx_tbl, 12))

# (b) Marginal probabilities (hold the other factor at draw-wise mean) — report means
marginal_month <- function(b0, bmon, byear, method_label, labels_vec){
  By <- rowMeans(byear, na.rm=TRUE)
  L  <- ncol(as.data.frame(bmon))
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(L), function(m){
    p  <- inv_logit(b0 + bmon[,m] + By)
    qs <- quantile(p, c(.025,.975), na.rm=TRUE)
    tibble(Method = method_label, Month = labels_vec[m],
           p_mean = mean(p, na.rm = TRUE),
           p_lo95 = qs[1], p_hi95 = qs[2])
  }))
}
marginal_year <- function(b0, bmon, byear, method_label, labels_vec){
  Bm <- rowMeans(bmon, na.rm=TRUE)
  L  <- ncol(as.data.frame(byear))
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(L), function(ti){
    p  <- inv_logit(b0 + Bm + byear[,ti])
    qs <- quantile(p, c(.025,.975), na.rm=TRUE)
    tibble(Method = method_label, Year = labels_vec[ti],
           p_mean = mean(p, na.rm = TRUE),
           p_lo95 = qs[1], p_hi95 = qs[2])
  }))
}

pm_tbl <- bind_rows(
  marginal_month(s$beta0_call, s$beta_mon_call, by_call, "Call files",  labs_for_months(s$beta_mon_call)),
  marginal_month(s$beta0_dip,  s$beta_mon_dip,  by_dip,  "Dipnet surveys", labs_for_months(s$beta_mon_dip)),
  if (!is.null(s$beta0_egg))
    marginal_month(s$beta0_egg, s$beta_mon_egg, by_egg, "Egg mass surveys", labs_for_months(s$beta_mon_egg))
)
py_tbl <- bind_rows(
  marginal_year(s$beta0_call, s$beta_mon_call, by_call, "Call files",  labs_for_years(by_call)),
  marginal_year(s$beta0_dip,  s$beta_mon_dip,  by_dip,  "Dipnet surveys", labs_for_years(by_dip)),
  if (!is.null(s$beta0_egg))
    marginal_year(s$beta0_egg, s$beta_mon_egg, by_egg, "Egg mass surveys", labs_for_years(by_egg))
)


cat("\n=== Detection — marginal probabilities by Month (overall) ===\n")
print(head(pm_tbl, 12))
cat("\n=== Detection — marginal probabilities by Year (overall) ===\n")
print(py_tbl, n = Inf)

# ---------------- Done ----------------
```

```{r}
# ---- Detection summary table (mean, 95% CI, Bayesian p-value = Pr(same sign as mean)) ----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

stopifnot(exists("fit"), !is.null(fit$sims.list))
s <- fit$sims.list
# ---- implied per-year effects from the scalar slope β_year ----
stopifnot(exists("year_c"), exists("all_years"))
by_call <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_call), year_c)  # [draw] x [year]
by_dip  <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_dip ), year_c)
by_egg  <- if (!is.null(s$beta_yr_egg)) outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_egg), year_c) else NULL
colnames(by_call) <- colnames(by_dip) <- as.character(all_years)
if (!is.null(by_egg)) colnames(by_egg) <- as.character(all_years)


# Helper already defined earlier; re-define here if not in scope
if (!exists("pr_same_sign")) {
  pr_same_sign <- function(v){
    m <- mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(m) || m == 0) return(NA_real_)
    mean(sign(v) == sign(m), na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

# Build a tidy table for one method's detection parameters
one_method_detection_tbl <- function(method){
  # method is one of "call", "dip", "egg"
  b0   <- s[[paste0("beta0_", method)]]
  bmon <- s[[paste0("beta_mon_", method)]]
 byear <- switch(method,
  "call" = by_call,
  "dip"  = by_dip,
  "egg"  = by_egg
)


  out <- list()

  # Intercept
  if (!is.null(b0)) {
    out$intercept <- tibble(
      VARIABLE   = "β₀",
      DEFINITION = paste0(toupper(substr(method,1,1)), substr(method,2,999),
                          " detection intercept"),
      MEAN       = mean(b0, na.rm = TRUE),
      `95% CI (lo)` = quantile(b0, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      `95% CI (hi)` = quantile(b0, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      `BAYESIAN P-VALUE` = pr_same_sign(b0)
    )
  }

  # Month effects (if present)
  if (!is.null(bmon)) {
    Lm <- ncol(as.data.frame(bmon))
    mon_labs <- month.name[seq_len(Lm)]
    mon_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(Lm), function(i){
      v <- bmon[, i]
      tibble(
        VARIABLE   = paste0("β_mon[", i, "]"),
        DEFINITION = paste0("Month effect: ", mon_labs[i], " (", 
                            toupper(substr(method,1,1)), substr(method,2,999), ")"),
        MEAN       = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
        `95% CI (lo)` = quantile(v, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        `95% CI (hi)` = quantile(v, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        `BAYESIAN P-VALUE` = pr_same_sign(v)
      )
    }))
    out$month <- mon_tbl
  }

  # Year effects (if present)
  if (!is.null(byear)) {
    Ly <- ncol(as.data.frame(byear))
    yr_labs <- if (exists("all_years")) as.character(all_years)[seq_len(Ly)] else paste0("Year_", seq_len(Ly))
    yr_tbl <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(Ly), function(i){
      v <- byear[, i]
      tibble(
        VARIABLE   = paste0("β_year[", i, "]"),
        DEFINITION = paste0("Year effect: ", yr_labs[i], " (", 
                            toupper(substr(method,1,1)), substr(method,2,999), ")"),
        MEAN       = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
        `95% CI (lo)` = quantile(v, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        `95% CI (hi)` = quantile(v, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        `BAYESIAN P-VALUE` = pr_same_sign(v)
      )
    }))
    out$year <- yr_tbl
  }

  bind_rows(out)
}

det_tables <- list()

if (!is.null(s$beta0_call) || !is.null(s$beta_mon_call) || !is.null(s$beta_yr_call)) {
  det_tables$Call <- one_method_detection_tbl("call") %>% mutate(METHOD = "Call files", .before = 1)
}
if (!is.null(s$beta0_dip)  || !is.null(s$beta_mon_dip)  || !is.null(s$beta_yr_dip)) {
  det_tables$Dip  <- one_method_detection_tbl("dip")  %>% mutate(METHOD = "Dipnet surveys", .before = 1)
}
if (!is.null(s$beta0_egg)  || !is.null(s$beta_mon_egg)  || !is.null(s$beta_yr_egg)) {
  det_tables$Egg  <- one_method_detection_tbl("egg")  %>% mutate(METHOD = "Egg mass surveys", .before = 1)
}

# Final table (stacked)
det_summary_tbl <- bind_rows(det_tables) %>%
  # nice ordering: Method, Intercept, Months, Years
  mutate(.ord = dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^β₀$", VARIABLE) ~ 1,
    grepl("^β_mon\\[", VARIABLE) ~ 2,
    grepl("^β_year\\[", VARIABLE) ~ 3,
    TRUE ~ 4
  )) %>%
  arrange(METHOD, .ord, VARIABLE) %>%
  select(-.ord)

# Print and optionally write CSV
cat("\n=== Detection model parameter summary (means, 95% CrI, Pr[same sign as mean]) ===\n")
print(det_summary_tbl, n = 30)

readr::write_csv(det_summary_tbl, "detection_parameter_summary.csv")
```

```{r}
# ---- Compact detection table: Intercept, pooled Month, pooled Year (per method) ----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

s <- fit$sims.list
# ---- implied per-year effects from the scalar slope β_year ----
stopifnot(exists("year_c"), exists("all_years"))
by_call <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_call), year_c)  # [draw] x [year]
by_dip  <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_dip ), year_c)
by_egg  <- if (!is.null(s$beta_yr_egg)) outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_egg), year_c) else NULL
colnames(by_call) <- colnames(by_dip) <- as.character(all_years)
if (!is.null(by_egg)) colnames(by_egg) <- as.character(all_years)


# If not already defined
if (!exists("pr_same_sign")) {
  pr_same_sign <- function(v){
    m <- mean(v, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.na(m) || m == 0) return(NA_real_)
    mean(sign(v) == sign(m), na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

summ_from_draws <- function(v, label){
  tibble(
    VARIABLE              = label,
    MEAN                  = mean(v, na.rm = TRUE),
    `95% CI (lo)`         = quantile(v, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    `95% CI (hi)`         = quantile(v, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    `BAYESIAN P-VALUE`    = pr_same_sign(v)
  )
}

one_method_compact <- function(method, method_label){
  b0    <- s[[paste0("beta0_", method)]]
  bmon  <- s[[paste0("beta_mon_", method)]]
    byear <- switch(method,
    "call" = by_call,
    "dip"  = by_dip,
    "egg"  = by_egg
  )

  out <- list()

  # Intercept
  if (!is.null(b0)) {
    out$intercept <- summ_from_draws(b0, "β₀ (intercept)")
  }

  # Pooled Month effect: row-mean across months within each draw
  if (!is.null(bmon)) {
    bm <- as.data.frame(bmon)         # [iter x nMonth]
    pooled_month <- rowMeans(bm, na.rm = TRUE)
    out$month <- summ_from_draws(pooled_month, "β_month (pooled)")
  }

  # Pooled Year effect: row-mean across years within each draw
  if (!is.null(byear)) {
    by <- as.data.frame(byear)        # [iter x nYear]
    pooled_year <- rowMeans(by, na.rm = TRUE)
    out$year <- summ_from_draws(pooled_year, "β_year (pooled)")
  }

  bind_rows(out) %>% mutate(METHOD = method_label, .before = 1)
}

det_compact_tbl <- bind_rows(
  if (!is.null(s$beta0_call) || !is.null(s$beta_mon_call) || !is.null(s$beta_yr_call))
    one_method_compact("call", "Call files"),
  if (!is.null(s$beta0_dip)  || !is.null(s$beta_mon_dip)  || !is.null(s$beta_yr_dip))
    one_method_compact("dip",  "Dipnet surveys"),
  if (!is.null(s$beta0_egg)  || !is.null(s$beta_mon_egg)  || !is.null(s$beta_yr_egg))
    one_method_compact("egg",  "Egg mass surveys")
) %>%
  arrange(METHOD, factor(VARIABLE, levels = c("β₀ (intercept)","β_month (pooled)","β_year (pooled)")))

cat("\n=== Detection model (compact): intercept, pooled Month, pooled Year ===\n")
print(det_compact_tbl, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# --- Overall detection estimate (posterior, model-based) ---
inv_logit <- function(x) 1/(1+exp(-x))
s <- fit$sims.list
# implied per-year effects from the scalar slope β_year
stopifnot(exists("year_c"), exists("all_years"))
by_call <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_call), year_c)
by_dip  <- outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_dip ), year_c)
by_egg  <- if (!is.null(s$beta_yr_egg)) outer(as.numeric(s$beta_yr_egg), year_c) else NULL
colnames(by_call) <- colnames(by_dip) <- as.character(all_years)
if (!is.null(by_egg)) colnames(by_egg) <- as.character(all_years)

overall_det <- function(method = c("call", "dip", "egg")) {
  method <- match.arg(method)
  b0   <- s[[paste0("beta0_", method)]]
  bmon <- s[[paste0("beta_mon_", method)]]
  by <- switch(method,
  "call" = by_call,
  "dip"  = by_dip,
  "egg"  = by_egg
)

  stopifnot(!is.null(b0), !is.null(bmon), !is.null(by))

  M  <- ncol(as.data.frame(bmon))
  Tt <- ncol(as.data.frame(by))

  p_draws <- rowMeans(do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(M), function(m)
    sapply(seq_len(Tt), function(t) inv_logit(b0 + bmon[, m] + by[, t]))
  )), na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    method = method,
    p_mean = mean(p_draws),
    p_lo95 = quantile(p_draws, 0.025),
    p_hi95 = quantile(p_draws, 0.975)
  )
}

# Example for all three methods:
overall_det("call")
overall_det("dip")
overall_det("egg")  # only if egg survey params exist
```
